Color Filters engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

US/EU indie teams conflate system color-filter capability with storefront language. iOS Settings and App Store Connect actually separate them:

  • Color Filters on the device — iOS applies display tint presets — Grayscale, Red/Green filter, Green/Red filter, Blue/Yellow filter, Color Tint — with an intensity slider under Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size → Color Filters. Optional Color Filters shortcut in Control Center or Accessibility Shortcuts. System accessibility behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • Color-filter APIs and in-app tint logic — code that detects system color filters, adapts custom UI, or ships companion filter demos. Engineering inside the binary — not listing rewrite.
  • Color Filters marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app works with Color Filters, supports Grayscale, or helps color-vision users. Connect text fields — this page.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China storefront. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of how strongly your US listing markets Color Filters.

An app that references Color Filters in onboarding and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe color-filter presets and 色觉辅助 value on the store page, not whether Color Filters toggles inside iOS Settings.

The Color Filters preset family — what your listing may claim

Apple ships several Color Filters presets under the same toggle. AppLocale covers whichever your US page and screenshots already claim — paste-ready zh-Hans copy per preset, not invented scope:

  • Grayscale (灰度) — full-screen desaturation for color-vision or focus needs. Gallery frames may show before/after grayscale demos or "Grayscale" badges.
  • Red/Green filter & Green/Red filter — protanopia and deuteranopia-oriented tint presets. Caption lines may reference red/green or green/red filter pickers when your English listing already shows them.
  • Blue/Yellow filter — tritanopia-oriented tint preset. Include in zh-Hans copy only when your US gallery or description already claims it.
  • Color Tint (色彩滤镜 / 颜色滤镜) — custom hue and intensity overlay. Marketing art may highlight the tint picker and intensity slider.

  • Color Filters shortcut (颜色滤镜快捷键) — quick toggle via Control Center or Accessibility Shortcuts. Include when your US listing already markets shortcut setup — AppLocale does not invent shortcut claims your English page does not show.

Your gallery may lead with a Grayscale demo on one frame and a Color Tint intensity slider on the next. zh-Hans caption lines should name the correct preset per frame — a color-filter picker is not an Increase Contrast toggle, not a Smart Invert badge, and not a Night Shift warmth slider unless that is what the screenshot shows.

Color Filters-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Color-vision marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Color Filters in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Official Settings vocabulary

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 颜色滤镜 for Color Filters, with related buyer language around 色彩滤镜 (color tint), 灰度 (Grayscale), 色觉辅助 (color-vision assistance), 色盲滤镜 (color-blind filter — commerce phrasing, not clinical claims), 显示与文字大小 (Display & Text Size under 辅助功能 → 无障碍), and 颜色滤镜快捷键 (Color Filters shortcut). Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not generic 视力 or medical eye-exam claims that could imply clinical products.

Color Filters vs Classic Invert and Smart Invert

Invert modes live under the same Accessibility menu branch — but they flip screen colors rather than apply vision-oriented tint presets. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 反色 or 智能反色 when your English source only shows a Grayscale or Color Tint picker. See the Display Accommodations listing guide only if invert colors are your lead marketing claim.

Color Filters vs Differentiate Without Color

Differentiate Without Color helps apps use shapes and labels instead of color alone — 不用颜色区分. Color Filters tints the display for color-vision needs — 颜色滤镜, 色觉辅助. If your English gallery shows a shape-based differentiation demo, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to 色盲滤镜 claims unless color filters are what the frame depicts.

Color Filters vs Increase Contrast and Reduce White Point

Increase Contrast strengthens button and icon borders — 增强对比度. Reduce White Point dims bright whites — 降低白点. Color Filters apply display tint presets — 颜色滤镜, 灰度. If your English gallery shows an Increase Contrast or reduce-white-point slider, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to color-filter claims unless that is what the frame shows. See the Increase Contrast listing guide or Display Accommodations listing guide only if those are your lead marketing claims.

Color Filters vs True Tone, Night Shift, Dark Mode, and Auto Brightness

True Tone adjusts white balance — 原彩显示. Night Shift shifts evening warmth — 夜览. Dark Mode changes UI appearance — 深色模式. Auto Brightness adjusts screen brightness to ambient light. Color Filters apply accessibility tint presets — 颜色滤镜. If your English gallery shows a color-temperature slider, dark-theme mockup, or brightness control, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to 色觉辅助 claims unless color filters are what the frame depicts. See the True Tone listing guide, Night Shift listing guide, or Dark Mode listing guide only if display color or appearance features are your lead marketing claim.

AppLocale FAQ

Is Color Filters the same as Classic Invert or Smart Invert?

No. Color Filters applies display tint presets — Grayscale, Red/Green filter, Color Tint — 颜色滤镜, 灰度. Classic Invert and Smart Invert flip screen colors — 反色, 智能反色. See our Display Accommodations listing guide only if invert is your lead marketing claim.

Is Color Filters the same as Differentiate Without Color?

No. Differentiate Without Color uses shapes and labels when color alone cannot convey meaning — 不用颜色区分. Color Filters tints the display for color-vision needs — 颜色滤镜, 色觉辅助. Different features, different Connect string families.

Is Color Filters the same as Increase Contrast or Reduce White Point?

No. Increase Contrast boosts UI element contrast — 增强对比度. Reduce White Point dims bright whites — 降低白点. Color Filters applies vision-oriented tint presets — 颜色滤镜. See our Increase Contrast listing guide or Display Accommodations listing guide for those claims.

Is Color Filters the same as True Tone, Night Shift, or Dark Mode?

No. True Tone, Night Shift, and Dark Mode market display color and appearance — 原彩显示, 夜览, 深色模式. Color Filters markets accessibility tint presets — 颜色滤镜. See our True Tone listing guide, Night Shift listing guide, or Dark Mode listing guide for display color and appearance copy.
